description_en: Uses a firewall template to apply firewall rules to multiple simple application servers at a time. This improves your efficiency of setting firewall rules
description_zh: 使用防火墙模板可以同时为多台轻量应用服务器实例设置防火墙规则，提高设置防火墙规则的效率
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open apply-firewall-template --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --firewall-template-id ft-bcf1a7hrdq7170000 --instance-ids d9e781ff8a8f49ee812796f127990000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ApplyFirewallTemplate

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application server. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查询可用地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the firewall template
parameters.name: firewall_template_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the simple application servers
parameters.help_zh: 轻量应用服务器的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_ids

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the execution to apply the template
